decision: The official SamsungLabs source describes a materially relevant controlled illumination and multi-camera RAW observation with explicit train, validation and test roles. It is not eligible for this product-oriented research path because the release is explicitly noncommercial and publishes no exact dataset archive size, asset manifest or checksums. P272 therefore closes before any dataset-object request and does not consume candidate 3.
preformal_and_infrastructure_exclusions: Before formal lock, one focused run exposed Windows checkout CRLF translation. The audit was changed to read exact Git object bytes; no dataset object or pixel was requested.
Before formal lock, one focused run exposed read-only Git pack cleanup on Windows. Owned temporary clone cleanup was made attribute-safe; no scientific result existed.

During formal execution, the first reverse process stopped at GitHub clone with exit 128 and produced no report. The same frozen reverse process was retried once and completed byte-exact with the forward report.
claim_ceiling: Current official source eligibility only; no dataset acquisition, pixel integrity, operator, quality, package/schema/capability/product mapping or candidate-3 admission.
